| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Inside | Inside, Boundaries over the image, Edge stopping image | The inside of the final contour as a label map, drawn over the image and listed in the Features panel. Or its boundary in yellow over the image. Or the edge stopping image g as gray, white in flat areas and dark on edges. |
| **Balloon force** `balloon` | -1 | -5 to 5 | Below 0 the contour shrinks, above 0 it grows, by one pixel per step where the image is flat enough. A larger size lets it push past weaker edges. scikit-image uses 0. |
| **Iterations** `iterations` | 100 | 1 to 1000 | The number of steps. Each step moves the contour by at most about one pixel. |
| **Smoothing** `smoothing` | 1 | 0 to 4 | How many times the curvature smoothing runs in each step. scikit-image uses 1. |
| **Edge smoothing** `sigma` | 2 | 0.5 to 10 px | The sigma of the Gaussian in the gradient of the edge stopping image. scikit-image uses 5. We use 2, which kept the contour closer to a disk with a sharp edge in our tests. |
| **Edge contrast** `alpha` | 100 | 1 to 1000 | The steepness alpha of the edge stopping image. scikit-image uses 100. |
